query: UPDATE analytics_fact_changes SET state='pending',lease_worker=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error='Fact processing failed; retry scheduled',next_attempt_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>LEAST(attempts,60)::double precision) WHERE owner_id=$1 AND change_id=$2 AND state='leased' AND lease_worker=$3 AND lease_epoch=$4 AND lease_until>now()
